beats.name: Private briefing — double-meaning banter
beats.plot: Bhalla and Sandeep call Ankita to their office briefing room. Their release review quickly becomes a two-way, double-meaning, playful exchange. Both compliment her distinctly and actively; neither man's compliment count is restricted. Ankita gives back smart provocative jokes and keeps the initiative. Bhalla is 58 and an external senior client consultant; Sandeep is 38 and her delivery manager. Their private reactions have different voice and tempo.

beats.name: Morning compliment recall → beauty test
beats.plot: Morning comments by Priya and Nisha in approved EP02 A08, plus later reactions from other men and women, return to Ankita's mind. She wonders whether her figure is truly as striking as people say, turning curiosity into an ego challenge: 'Am I really that beautiful? Let's test it.' She deliberately relaxes the upper two buttons / fit of her existing top herself to test their gaze and response during briefing, and controls her stance and movement. Their eyes linger as the room temperature metaphorically rises. Both trade playful dirty/dark double meanings, exchange repeated body-focused compliments, and conspicuously self-adjust their ties and trousers. No physical touch; visual cues and Ankita's deliberate leading body language drive the experiment. All three are adults.

beats.name: Aishwarya confrontation cliff — immediately after beauty test
beats.plot: Immediately after the 14:45–15:00 beauty test, Ankita leaves the briefing room with her beige blazer in hand (removed at the exit), upper two kurti buttons still loosened and a warm face. Aishwarya notices and asks about the sign-off, the buttons and Bhalla/Sandeep. Ankita says it was just compliments and deflects with 'Baad mein baat karte hain' before walking away. She is self-conscious but does not tremble or panic. No extra 20-minute meeting or personal presentation occurs. Aishwarya does not learn exactly what happened; the exchange remains unresolved.
